Name: ramp
Description: Indicates a location where a pedestrian must make a decision about which direction to travel, most commonly in locations where a curb ramp does or should exist.

Name: transit_stop (point)
Description: A node indicating the location of a transit stop of any kind.

Name: issue
Description: A marker indicating a particular spot that has an issue relevant to routing for some users.

Name: object
Description: A physical object that may be an amenity or an obstruction for some users. Objects are represented as points and are not connected to the graph network. A buffer may be drawn around objects relevant to routing to create a node in the network at their location.

Name: signal
Description: Used for adding detail on how a traffic signal controls ped/bike movements?

Name: elevator
Description: Elevators, funiculars or other car- or enclosure-based constructions meant to carry a pedestrian from one level of physical infrastructure to another. NC-BPAID maps outdoor infrastructure; switch to GTFS Pathways or IMDF conventions for indoor infrastructure.
